description: Land Acquisition - Samagipura and Diggalpura, Atambaoya, Vedehapura, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and extents for acquisition for public purposes. While it mentions a government minister (Minister of Lands), the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
